content: Xenni tᵉttwaẓar ict n řeɛřamet tameqqrant deg ujenna: ict n tmeṭṭut tyarḍ tafuct, u taziri sadu iḍaren nnes uca ɣares x uzeǧif nnes ijj n ttaj s tenɛac n itran.
Tuɣa teksi ddeyset, tesɣuyyu s řewjeɛ, tᵉttwaḥṣar s unezbar n tarut.
Xenni tᵉttwaẓar ict n řeɛřamet nneɣni deg ujenna, aqa din ict n řhaycet tameqqrant tazeggwaɣt am tmessi, ɣares sebɛa n izeǧifen d ɛecra n waccawen, uca x izeǧifen nnes sebɛa n ttijan.
uca akennas nnes ifarḍ ict n ttuřut n itran zeg ujenna, tessẓareyyeḍ i-ten ɣar temmurt. Uca řhaycet tuɣa tbedd zzat i tmeṭṭut i ɣa yarwen, ḥima ad tṣarḍ Mmis xmi t-i-dd i ɣa taruw.
Uca turuw-dd Mmis, Aryaz nni i ɣa iḥekmen x marra řegnus s uzeǧaḍ n wuzzař, uca Mmis immeksi deɣya ɣar AREBBI u ɣar řɛarc nnes.
Maca tameṭṭut tarweř ɣar řexřa, ɣar mani tuɣa d as igga AREBBI amcan ḥima ad as sseccen, řqedd n wařef u-mitayn u-settin n wussan.
Uca ikkar umenɣi deg ujenna. Mixayil d lmalakat nnes mmenɣent ak-d řhaycet, uca uřa d řhaycet d lmalakat nnes mmenɣent,
maca nitni war jhiden ca uca war ittwif ɛad wemcan deg ujenna i nitni.

Temmenḍar-dd řhaycet tameqqrant, nettat d ufiɣar nni tuɣa zic, qqaren as ‘ibřis’ niɣ ‘cciṭan’, wenni iɣekkwan marra tammurt, wah, aqa immenḍar-dd x temmurt uca lmalakat nnes mmenḍarent-i-dd ɛawed akides.
Uca sřiɣ ict n tmijja tameqqrant zeg ujenna teqqar s jjehd:
“Aqa yusa-dd ufekki d ṣṣulṭa d Tgeldit n AREBBI nneɣ, minzi wenni iḍeřmen aytmatneɣ, aqa immenḍar, wenni i ten iḍeřmen ass d ǧiřet.
Ɣellben xas s Idammen n Izmar, d wawař n cchadet nnes, uca nitni war ssɛizzen ca tudart nsen ař řmewt.
X uyenni, farḥem, a ijenwan d yinni daysen izeddɣen! Uct x temmurt d řebḥar, ibřis aqa ihwa-dd ɣarwem s tefqeḥt nnes imɣaren aṭṭas, issen ad ɣares iqqim drust n řweqt waha.”
Ařami řhaycet tufa ixef nnes temmenḍar ɣar temmurt, teḍfar tameṭṭut i dd-yurwen Mmis d Awtem.

Mmewcen as i tmeṭṭut tnayen n wefriwen n ugider ameqqran, ḥima ad teḍwu ɣar wemcan nnes di řexřa, maḥend ad tᵉttwassecc dinni, ijj n řmijař n řweqt d řewqat d ijj n wezyen n yijj n řmijař n řweqt, mani war tt iẓarr ufiɣar.
Afiɣar issusef zeg uqemmum nnes awarni i tmeṭṭut, igga ict n řḥemřet n waman am yeɣzar, ḥima ad tt awyen waman.
Tammurt tɛawen tameṭṭut uca tarzem temmurt aqemmum nnes, teḥruw iɣzar wenni dd-issusfen řhaycet zeg uqemmum nnes.
Uca řhaycet txeyyeq aṭṭas x tmeṭṭut uca tuyur ḥima ad temmneɣ ak-d yinni iqqimen zi zzariɛet nnes uca ak-d inni itteṭṭfen di tweṣṣa n AREBBI u di cchadet n Yasuɛ.

footnotes.text: accawen- nitni d iqaccawen n lḥayawan.
ijj n řmijař n řweqt d řewqat d ijj n wezyen n yijj n řmijař n řweqt- man aya ixs ad yini ‘ijj n useggʷas d tnayen n iseggʷusa d wezyen n useggʷas’. Xzar Asa. 12:6.
zzariɛet nnes- ixs ad yini Lmasiḥ (xzar Amz. 3:15) u yenni iqqimen aqa-ten d řmuminin inni yumnen di Lmasiḥ.
